title: 第6章 神秘召唤第7章 万兽血池
content_zh:
“小伦，再上。”
肖恩眼中的森冷光泽，也是陡然浓郁起来，现在，终于到了将这个大怪物解决的时候。
咻！
肖恩话音刚落，小伦已经含怒扑上，他的瞳孔，同样是有着垂涎之色。
熔岩龙龟贪婪他的血脉，他又何尝不垂涎熔岩龙龟那龙龟之肉的味道。
望着暴冲上来的小伦，那熔岩龙龟眼中有着浓浓的残忍和贪婪，它的嘴巴在此时鼓起。
熊！
下一刻，它嘴巴猛然张开，顿时间，赤红的火焰宛如怒龙一般，自他的嘴中呼啸而出，直接是朝着小伦席卷而去。
这一口火焰，乃是它的本命真火，不但具有可怕的温度，而且还蕴含着它的血脉之力。
它相信，这一口火焰，足以将眼前这血脉尊贵的神秘小兽焚灭。
“把它吞了，小伦！”
见到熔岩龙龟喷出的本命真火，肖恩更是没有丝毫的担忧，他望着小伦开口道。
要说本命真火，无论是威力，又或者是血脉的尊贵，那熔岩龙龟就算是给小伦提鞋也不配。
不过，一直以来小伦都是习惯了暴力血拼，肖恩正好是利用战斗指点小伦觉醒更多的天赋技能。
听到肖恩的说话，小伦也是缓缓的点了点头，下一刻，他的嘴巴微张，有红蓝之光萦绕，直接是化为一圈红蓝小漩涡出现在了小嘴之前，吞噬之力涌动，一口便是将那席卷而来的赤红火焰吞噬了进去。
嗤嗤嗤！
在本命真火被源源不断吞噬时，那熔岩龙龟的气息迅速萎靡，一张狰狞脸庞之上，满是惊恐之色。
这种吞噬，它竟然无法挣脱，被拖得越久，它的本命真火便是消耗得越快，而这样一直的拖下去，迟早都会血脉枯竭，毫无反抗。
“该结束了！”
不过，肖恩显然不想再节外生枝，此刻的地，早已跃到了熔岩龙龟的背上，指尖跳跃着的黑炎，狠狠的朝着后者的颈部按下。

嗤！
火中帝皇星辰之火，几乎是没有遇到丝毫的阻碍便顺着熔岩龙龟的颈部渗入。
“昂！”
剧痛在这一刻自熔岩龙龟体内爆发出来，它猛的痛苦厉吼，那种感觉，宛如颈部被强行塞入一座火山似的，正是焚灭它体内的生机。
“爆！”
肖恩冷漠的望着这一幕，低沉喝声陡然自嘴中吐出。
噗！
漆黑的火焰炸开，低沉的声音，在这一刻，自熔岩龙龟的体内响起，—股青烟自其颈部直接冒起。
熔岩龙龟的头颅迅速垂下，体内的生机，在此时被彻底的抹除。
熔岩中的深处，一个三丈方圆的真空地带，一小朵宛如深红鲜花般的火焰缓缓的舞动着傲娇的身姿，吞吐着一粒拇指般大小，散发着绚丽璀璨红芒的玄珠。
肖恩顺着感应，来到了这里，眼神火热的望着这朵艳丽的火焰和裹挟着的玄珠，深深的吸了一口气：“终于找到你了。”
出现在眼前的“地心玄火”和“火玄珠”，正是他拼尽艰险要寻找玄材。
地心玄火生长在这片低级的山脉中，成长得极是缓慢，现在只是一种幼生期的状态，肖恩释放出灵魂力量稍稍的加以压制，轻易的就能将它收服了。
从地心玄火中剥离了一丝玄火火种，肖恩将剩下的那朵地心玄火连同熔岩龙龟的兽晶叫小伦吞噬炼化。
content_en:
"Xiao Lun, come on again."
The cold luster in Sean's eyes suddenly became intense. Now, it was finally time to deal with this big monster.
call out!
As soon as Xiao En finished speaking, Xiao Lun rushed towards him with anger, and his pupils were also salivating.
The Lava Dragon Turtle is greedy for his blood, and why doesn't he covet the taste of the Dragon Turtle's meat?
Looking at Xiao Lun who rushed up, the lava dragon turtle's eyes were full of cruelty and greed, and its mouth bulged at this moment.
Bear!
The next moment, its mouth suddenly opened, and instantly, red flames roared out of his mouth like an angry dragon and swept directly towards Xiao Lun.
This flame is its true fire. It not only has a terrifying temperature, but also contains the power of its blood.
It believed that this flame was enough to burn out the mysterious little beast with noble blood in front of it.
"Swallow it, Xiao Lun!"
Seeing the true fire emitted by the lava dragon turtle, Sean was not worried at all. He looked at Xiao Lun and said.
In terms of true fire, regardless of its power or the nobility of its bloodline, the lava dragon turtle is not worthy even to carry Xiao Lun's shoes.
However, Xiao Lun has always been accustomed to violent fighting, and Sean happened to use the battle to teach Xiao Lun to awaken more talents and skills.
Hearing Sean's words, Xiao Lun also nodded slowly. The next moment, his mouth opened slightly, and there was a red and blue light lingering. It turned into a small red and blue vortex and appeared in front of the small mouth. The devouring power surged, and he swallowed the sweeping red flames in one mouthful.
Tsk tsk tsk!
When the true fire of his life was being continuously devoured, the aura of the lava dragon turtle quickly withered, and his ferocious face was full of panic.
It is unable to break free from this kind of devouring. The longer it is delayed, the faster its true fire is consumed. If it continues like this, sooner or later, its blood will dry up and there will be no resistance.
"It's over!"
However, Sean obviously didn't want to cause trouble. At this moment, the ground had already jumped on the back of the lava dragon turtle, and the black flames dancing on his fingertips were pressing hard towards the latter's neck.
laugh!
The fire of the Emperor's Star in the Fire seeped down the neck of the Lava Dragon Turtle without encountering any obstacles.
"Ang!"
Severe pain erupted from the lava dragon turtle's body at this moment, and it roared in pain. The feeling was as if its neck was being forced into a volcano, and it was burning out the vitality in its body.
"Explode!"
Sean looked at this scene indifferently, and a low drink suddenly came out of his mouth.
puff!
The dark flames exploded, and at this moment, a deep sound sounded from the lava dragon turtle's body, and a stream of blue smoke rose directly from its neck.
The lava dragon turtle's head quickly dropped, and the vitality in his body was completely wiped out at this moment.
Deep in the lava, in a three-foot-square vacuum zone, a small flame like a crimson flower slowly danced proudly, swallowing a black bead the size of a thumb, emitting brilliant red light.
Sean followed the induction and came here. He looked at the gorgeous flames and the enveloping mysterious beads with fiery eyes, and took a deep breath: "Finally I found you."
The "Earth Mysterious Fire" and "Fire Mysterious Pearl" that appeared in front of him were the mysterious materials he had gone through all the trouble to find.
The Earth's Mysterious Fire grew in this low-level mountain range, and it grew very slowly. Now it was only in its infancy. Sean released his soul power to suppress it slightly, and he could easily subdue it.
After stripping away a trace of the Mysterious Fire from the Earth's Core Fire, Sean asked Xiao Lun to devour and refine the remaining Earth's Core Fire together with the beast crystal of the Lava Dragon Turtle.
